g.text: CAN A / CAN B — integrated development interfaces

g.desc: CAN A / CAN B — integrated development interfaces

g.text: Development branch power: separate TPS2553 + 1 ohm rails feed VCC / VIO and local caps.

g.desc: Development branch power: separate TPS2553 + 1 ohm rails feed VCC / VIO and local caps.

g.text: TXD / STB old pullups stay on shared +3V3 before 1k series parts; RXD has MCU-side 47k pullup.

g.desc: TXD / STB old pullups stay on shared +3V3 before 1k series parts; RXD has MCU-side 47k pullup.

g.text: STB HIGH = branch OFF (no CAN wake); LOW = normal. See CAN Branch Power sheet.

g.desc: STB HIGH = branch OFF (no CAN wake); LOW = normal. See CAN Branch Power sheet.

g.text: Shared +3V3, GND, MCU and clock remain common failure paths; fault / PVT acceptance OPEN.

g.desc: Shared +3V3, GND, MCU and clock remain common failure paths; fault / PVT acceptance OPEN.

g.text: Existing TCAN custom symbols and manufacturer patterns reused.

g.desc: Existing TCAN custom symbols and manufacturer patterns reused.

g.text: Pin maps verified; assembly, ESD, timing and physical placement not qualified.

g.desc: Pin maps verified; assembly, ESD, timing and physical placement not qualified.

g.text: S08 construction review / S11 field-display limitations remain open.

g.desc: S08 construction review / S11 field-display limitations remain open.

g.text: R106/R107 DNP: fit 120 ohm only at actual bus ends.

g.desc: R106/R107 DNP: fit 120 ohm only at actual bus ends.

g.text: Power/package selection pending sustained differential-fault budget.

g.desc: Power/package selection pending sustained differential-fault budget.

g.text: Population is a custom field; native DNP-setting API unavailable.
